import json,os
prog='''def transform(grid):
    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bar=[c for c in set(cnt)-{0} if cnt[c]>=3 and c not in (1,)]
    # find the bar: rows/cols with >=3 consecutive same-colored cells per column
    # bar detection: color appearing as vertical 3-run in a column, in a group
    # simpler: identify colors forming the palette bar = cells not part of the main shape
    # main shape color = color with most cells forming the drawn shape
    # Find bar: contiguous block of columns where each column has 3 identical nonzero cells stacked
    bcols=[]
    for c in range(W):
        col=[grid[r][c] for r in range(H)]
        if any(col[r]!=0 and col[r]==col[r+1]==col[r+2] for r in range(H-2)):
            bcols.append((c,col))
    colors=[col for c,col in bcols if c==bcols[0][0] or True]
    # dedupe consecutive: bar columns
    palette=[]
    for c,col in bcols:
        v=col[[r for r in range(H-2) if col[r]!=0 and col[r]==col[r+1]==col[r+2]][0]]
        palette.append(v)
    # find shape color & cells: nonzero cells not in bar columns region
    barcols=set(c for c,_ in bcols)
    shape_cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if grid[r][c]!=0 and c not in barcols]
    scolor=grid[shape_cells[0][0]][shape_cells[0][1]]
    rs=[r for r,c in shape_cells]; cs=[c for r,c in shape_cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    rel=[[1 if v!=0 else 0 for v in row] for row in pattern]
    h=r1-r0+1
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    idx=palette.index(scolor)
    start=r0-idx*h
    for i,col in enumerate(palette):
        off=start+i*h
        for dr,row in enumerate(rel):
            for dc,v in enumerate(row):
                if v:
                    rr=off+dr
                    if 0<=rr<H: out[rr][c0+dc]=col
    return out
'''
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
open('programs/task-d0a25bb4.py','w').write(prog)
exec(compile(prog,'p','exec'),globals())
